name: e2e_messy_wash_and_lyse_assay_c2: wash, lyse, incubate, image
description: UNROUTED. Built by assay2chip/stages/s6_build.py from partition.json: op 6 wash -> polygon_chamber 'wash_6', op 8 wash -> polygon_chamber 'wash_8', op 10 lyse -> polygon_chamber 'lyse_10', op 12 incubate -> serpentine_channel 'incubate_12', op 13 image -> polygon_chamber 'image_13', op 14 lyse -> polygon_chamber 'lyse_14', ops 16 lyse, 17 lyse -> polygon_chamber 'lyse_16', op 19 incubate -> polygon_chamber 'incubate_19'. wash, mix, lyse, incubate, image share one board; they run between 25 and 37 C; 15 ports, which the target envelope does not cap; 4% of the envelope 127.76 x 85.48 mm (target envelope), ONE fluidic layer at ONE 0.3 mm etch depth, base and lid 0.5 / 1 mm. COP (Zeonor 1060R) because hot_embossing route; 90 C max working temperature covers the 37 C hold; DNA adsorption Low: hydrophobic, little DNA binding; protein/enzyme adsorption possible. The hottest hold here is 37 C. SIZED FROM THE LOAD, never from the paper's tube volumes (assay2chip/README.md, 'Bench volumes do not transfer'): wash_6 from 2,000 cells at 1500 per uL = 1.33 uL of suspension; wash_8 from 2,000 cells at 1500 per uL = 1.33 uL of suspension; lyse_10 from 2,000 cells at 1500 per uL = 1.33 uL of suspension; incubate_12 from 2,000 cells at 1500 per uL = 1.33 uL of suspension; image_13 from a stated floor area of 4 mm2 x the 0.3 mm etch depth, then grown to the smallest footprint a channel can attach to (1.40 mm a side); lyse_14 from 2,000 cells at 1500 per uL = 1.33 uL of suspension; lyse_16 from 2,000 cells at 1500 per uL = 1.33 uL of suspension (the largest load of op(s) 16, 17: op 16); incubate_19 from 2,000 cells at 1500 per uL = 1.33 uL of suspension. ONE PART PER PLACE (chip/designs/README.md rule 1): ops 16, 17 (lyse, lyse) all act on the same cells in 'lyse_16', so they share one chamber sized for the largest of their loads and held at each temperature in turn. PLACEMENT: parts sit in flow order in 1 row(s) (left to right), spread across the usable 121.4 x 79.1 mm so the slack between them is routing corridor. Total chain length 516.8 mm, crossing risk 0, nothing rotated; every feature keeps at least 0.4 mm to its neighbours and to the chip edge. PORTS: 4 (inlet_1, outlet_1, reagent_in, waste), each over a PORT PAD the registry sized, so the bore opens entirely onto cut area and the port-overlap rule in tools/check_chip_spec.py passes. Inlets and outlets are on opposite edges, which is what keeps the layout planar in one layer, and no two ports are closer than 5 mm. CHANNELS BETWEEN PARTS ARE DELIBERATELY EMPTY: S7 routes them from assay2chip/work/<id>/connections_e2e_messy_wash_and_lyse_assay_c2.json. Until it has run, a chamber here is unconnected on purpose, and every rule that needs a channel - channel width against capsule diameter, channel crossings, protocol targets - can only be checked after S7. REALISED AS CHANNELS, not as parts: op(s) 7 (mix) - op(s) 7 (mix) carry a stream and nothing states a residence time, so there is no length or volume to build to; realised as the connecting channel rather than as a part; op(s) 9 (mix) - op(s) 9 (mix) carry a stream and nothing states a residence time, so there is no length or volume to build to; realised as the connecting channel rather than as a part; op(s) 11 (mix) - op(s) 11 (mix) carry a stream and nothing states a residence time, so there is no length or volume to build to; realised as the connecting channel rather than as a part; op(s) 15 (mix) - op(s) 15 (mix) carry a stream and nothing states a residence time, so there is no length or volume to build to; realised as the connecting channel rather than as a part; op(s) 18 (mix) - op(s) 18 (mix) carry a stream and nothing states a residence time, so there is no length or volume to build to; realised as the connecting channel rather than as a part. A conduit is sized from flow and residence time, and one that comes out smaller than a face a channel can attach to is not a small part but an unusable one, so it becomes the channel instead, lengthened to the length it needs. Parts sized by assay2chip/parts/registry.py. RISKS carried from sizing: a 0.588 uL load across a 26.67 mm lane solves to a 0.0735 mm flow path, under the 200 um in-plane floor, so the chamber was lengthened to the floor and holds 1.6 uL - 3x the load. Recompute reagent ratios on the built volume.; this is a delay line, not a mixer: at Re << 1 folding adds residence time and nothing else (blocks.json herringbone_mixer is the mixing block).
